description: Breaks cold start into a span waterfall (`app_cold_start` root + `sdk_init` / `scene_render` / `state_restore` children — see `ColdStartSpans` in CaptureBridge.swift) instead of the single `logAppLaunchTTI` number. Five flows, one per span end log, feeding five Histogram charts: four give each phase (and the overall root) its own P50/P90/P99 breakdown, the fifth groups all three phases by `_span_name` on one chart for side-by-side comparison. Because workflow matching runs on-device against every span as it's emitted, these are exact per-session numbers, not a sample — unlike Instant Insights aggregates, every cold start any device produces contributes to the histograms. Use the per-phase charts to see if a regression is in SDK init, SwiftUI scene stand-up, or the demo's own prefs bookkeeping; use the compared chart to see which phase dominates overall cold-start time.
